sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Certificate of Insurance)

room_rent.note: Policy wording lists Room Rent as a covered expense under Benefit-1 but does not specify any cap or limit. Actual limit may be in Certificate of Insurance.

icu.note: ICU charges listed as covered under Benefit-1 but no specific cap mentioned in wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording. Aggregate Deductible applies instead.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; maternity capped at ₹1 lakh
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments sub-limited to 50% of Sum Insured. Maternity capped at ₹1 lakh. Ambulance capped at ₹3,500 per hospitalisation. No other disease-wise sub-limits stated.

deductible.display: Aggregate Deductible (amount per Certificate of Insurance)
deductible.note: An annual Aggregate Deductible applies; the exact rupee amount is specified in the Certificate of Insurance, not in the wording.

initial_waiting.note: Excl03: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Excl01: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage. Several conditions are permanently excluded if pre-existing at first proposal.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Excl02: Listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, eye, etc.) have 24-month waiting period.

maternity.display: Covered (12mo wait, up to ₹1 lakh, max 2 deliveries)
maternity.note: Benefit-3: Maternity covered up to ₹1 lakh per delivery/termination, available after 12 months from first policy inception, limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus or no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement of sum insured benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Section 3.1.3: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Section 3.1.3: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered but limited to the list specified in Annexure-I of the policy.

domiciliary.note: Benefit-2: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if condition continues for at least 3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, chronic nephritis, diarrhoea, epilepsy, influenza, pyrexia <10 days, tonsillitis, URTI, arthritis, gout, rheumatism.

ayush.note: Benefit-5: AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured (in excess of Aggregate Deductible) at AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre. No pre/post hospitalisation or overseas treatment.

organ_donor.note: Benefit-4: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses covered. Pre/post hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Benefit-6: Road ambulance covered up to ₹3,500 per hospitalisation for life-threatening emergencies certified by a Medical Practitioner.

modern_treatments.note: Benefit-7: Modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Annexure-II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly excludes treatment taken outside India (Section 4.1 exclusion 25 and Section 5.5 payment terms).

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, policy cannot be voided for non-disclosure except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Section 2 definition of Break in Insurance/Policy implies 30-day grace period for renewal.

free_look.note: Section 6.4 clause 11: Free look period of at least 15 days from date of receipt of policy for new policies.

portability.note: Portability defined in Section 2 and referenced in waiting period clauses per IRDAI norms.

notable_exclusions.display: Permanent exclusions: cancer, epilepsy, heart ailments, stroke, CKD, Hep B, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's if pre-existing; overseas treatment; dental (non-accident); sterility/IVF
